title: Connections
notice: Catalogue lookup, personal account authorization and financial reporting are separate connections. A catalogue result does not verify artist ownership or provide earnings reports.

services.label: Account services
services.detail: Verified shared Store and Studio sign-in.

services.label: Spotify catalogue
services.detail: Server-side artist search. This does not connect a personal Spotify account.

services.label: Apple Music catalogue lookup
services.detail: Public artist lookup through Apple's catalogue search; MusicKit authorization is separate.

services.label: Apple Music API / MusicKit
services.detail: Requires an Apple Developer MusicKit key and verified server-side token before activation.

services.label: Streaming reports
services.detail: Requires verified distributor reporting access; catalogue APIs do not provide royalty statements.

services.label: Royalty statements
services.detail: Requires verified statements and an approved earnings ledger.

services.label: Live payments and payouts
services.detail: Stripe verification, live configuration and payout policy are required. Sandbox card setup is separate.

services.label: Digital signatures
services.detail: A non-binding signing preview exists; production signing and evidence are not active.
